campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status FROM crafting_projects WHERE id = ?\",\n                (id,),\n            ).fetchone()\n            if row is None:\n                return None\n            campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status = row\n            if status == \"complete\":\n                return {\n                    \"id\": id,\n                    \"campaign_id\": campaign_id,\n                    \"character_id\": character_id,\n                    \"item_slug\": item_slug,\n                    \"days_required\": days_required,\n                    \"days_completed\": days_completed,\n                    \"status\": status,\n                }\n            new_days = min(days_completed + days, days_required)\n            new_status = \"complete\" if new_days >= days_required else \"active\"\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?,
